gloss: nama-fu; fresh wheat gluten (soft and chewy)

definitions.gloss: nama-fu; fresh wheat gluten (soft and chewy)
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese food made from wheat gluten mixed with glutinous rice flour, steamed to produce a soft, chewy texture. Eaten as a refined ingredient in Kyoto-style cuisine, Buddhist vegetarian cooking, and high-end Japanese restaurants.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ (fresh; uncooked; raw) and ⟦{麩|ふ}→麩：24202_fu⟧ (wheat gluten). The ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧ here signals that the product has not been dried or toasted, unlike ⟦{焼|や}き{麩|ふ}→焼き麩：23650_yakifu⟧ (baked, dry yaki-fu).

USAGE:
A specialty food associated particularly with Kyoto cuisine and ⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧ (Buddhist vegetarian cooking). Typically sold refrigerated in blocks and has a shelf life of only a few days. Popular varieties include {粟麩|あわふ} (with millet), {草麩|くさふ} (with mugwort, green-colored), and {紅葉麩|もみじふ} (autumn-leaf shape). Often grilled with miso glaze (⟦{田楽|でんがく}→田楽：13622_dengaku⟧) or served in clear soup as a refined garnish.

- {生麩|なまふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{田楽|でんがく}→田楽：13622_dengaku⟧: grilled nama-fu with miso glaze
- {生麩|なまふ}⟦{田楽|でんがく}→田楽：13622_dengaku⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧: miso used to top grilled nama-fu
